title: MP Materials Reports First Quarter 2026 Results
excerpt: Q1 2026 delivered 917 metric tons of NdPr production, 1,006 metric tons of NdPr sales, USD 90.6 million revenue, USD 42.3 million price-protection income, and USD 36.6 million adjusted EBITDA.
summary: The issuer release provides the latest production report, segment revenue and adjusted EBITDA, magnetics commercialization, 10X groundbreaking and consolidated financial highlights.
